Container.Name: rclone-manager
Container.Overview:
RClone Manager is a web interface for rclone: set up remotes (Google Drive, OneDrive, S3, Backblaze B2, SFTP and many more), browse them, and run or schedule sync, copy, move and bisync jobs. The container downloads the current rclone on first start and keeps it in the Data folder.
Your Unraid shares are mounted at /mnt/user, so use paths such as /mnt/user/backups as local sources and destinations.
Cloud sign-in (OAuth): rclone's sign-in callback only listens inside the container, so for Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox answer No to the browser question and paste a token made with: rclone authorize "drive" on a computer with a browser.
Optional: set a Master secret so saved remote passwords and tokens survive restarts, and a username and password to protect the web UI (or put it behind a reverse proxy). To mount remotes with FUSE, add to Extra Parameters: --device /dev/fuse --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --security-opt apparmor:unconfined
Template maintained by repires; RClone Manager is developed by Zarestia-Dev (GPL-3.0).

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. Unraid's own web UI may already use 8080; pick another port in that case.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: App settings, jobs, logs, cache and the downloaded rclone binary.

Config.Name: Unraid shares
Config.Description: Local storage for jobs. Keep it mounted outside /home/rclone-manager: the image changes ownership of everything under that folder (and /data, /config) at every start.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 (nobody) matches Unraid shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 (users) matches Unraid shares.

Config.Name: Master secret
Config.Description: Optional but recommended. Encrypts saved remote passwords and tokens; without it they are kept in memory only and must be re-entered after every restart.

Config.Name: Web UI username
Config.Description: Optional basic-auth username for the web UI. Leave empty when a reverse proxy handles login.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional basic-auth password for the web UI.
